claims: The 2027 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport returns as a wide-body variant.
The 2027 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport features a new 535-hp 6.7L LS6 V8.
Base pricing for the 2027 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport coupe starts at $88,495.
The 2027 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport is positioned between the Stingray and Z06.
The 2027 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport offers a Track Performance Package around $109,190.
The 2027 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport offers an all-wheel-drive Grand Sport X hybrid model producing 721 hp.
The 2027 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport has a 6.7L LS6 naturally aspirated V8 with 535 hp and 520 lb-ft of torque.
The 2027 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport has a wide-body chassis.
The 2027 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport has unique wheels inspired by the 1963 original.
The 2027 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport has a quad center-exit exhaust.
The standard 2027 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport has Magnetic Ride Control.
The standard 2027 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport has Z06-style brakes.
The standard 2027 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport has Michelin Pilot Sport 4S tires.
The Track Performance Package adds Michelin Pilot Sport Cup 2 R tires.
The Track Performance Package adds carbon-ceramic brakes.
The 2027 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport X is a hybrid AWD model with 721 hp.
The 2027 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport X effectively replaces the E-Ray.
Base pricing for the 2027 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport convertible starts at $95,495.
Orders for the 2027 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport are set to open in April 2026.
The 2027 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport X [is set to arrive] later in the summer.
